title: Beta client build 70374 (Oct 13): no item, spell, talent or recipe changes
claim: Beta client build 1.60.1.70374 appeared on Oct 13 (wago.tools build list, 4:25 PM PDT) and changes no items, spells, talents or recipes compared with 70338.
detail: forever-ref's automated refresh extracted 70374 on Oct 14; a diff of its items (19,248), spells (31,850) and recipes (2,650) against 70338 is empty. wowclassicforever.info's file comparison: 666 files differ (422 sound, 128 world-map textures, 17 program, 6 shader, 91 other) and only two data tables (ManifestInterfaceData, ManifestInterfaceItemIcon). It is a client/asset update, not the designer-announced Oct 15 content build.

title: Oct 15 build: designer-confirmed class fixes that affect leveling
claim: A Blizzard designer marked 16 forever-bugs issues fixed for the Oct 15 beta build, including Siphon Life crits (#303), Twin Disciplines for Mind Flay (#322) and SW:D (#328), Improved Berserker Rage breaking roots (#305), Malediction Hellfire (#311), Frost Channeling threat (#324), Soul Link via Talented below 30 (#302), Improved Mend Pet cost (#316), trap scaling (#283) and Restorative Totems for Healing Stream Totem (#291).
detail: Added Oct 14 (from the foreverchanges.pro bug-tracker summary): #291 Restorative Totems now also raises the healing power Healing Stream Totem gets; #300 Summon Hawk no longer flies to your target (including dead ones) after the cast; #321 Mind Vision no longer interrupts an enemy's drinking; #217 talent tooltips show ranks again; Legacy #309 Bountiful Harvest and #310 Luremaster give their extra materials/fish; #283 Immolation/Explosive Trap scale with AP/SP and a frost and a fire trap can be active together. Closed as intended: #304 Predator's Edge does not raise white-hit crit damage; #301 Tremor Totem stays 30 yd. #308 removes the Faerie Fire double-rank stack. Re-check Warlock and Shadow Priest damage after the build lands.

title: Ships: Menethil - Southshore - Auberdine loop (one way), Stormwind Harbor - Auberdine
claim: The new Alliance boat sails a one-way loop Menethil Harbor -> Southshore (~6 min) -> Auberdine (~3.5 min) -> Menethil (~3 min, no stop); Stormwind Harbor <-> Auberdine is two-way (~2.5 min).
detail: Direction and stops from classicwowforever.com and Factoruide (client TaxiPathNode paths 11167 and 11616). Ride times are Factoruide's estimates from path length, not timed in game. Consequence: Southshore -> Menethil means riding on through Auberdine (~6.5 min); Menethil -> Auberdine goes via Southshore (~9.5 min), so Stormwind Harbor -> Auberdine (~2.5 min) or the old Menethil-Auberdine habit no longer applies. Times exclude waiting at the dock.

title: Neutral boat Steamwheedle Port (Tanaris) <-> Powderfuse Port (Riverglades)
claim: A neutral two-way boat links Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris with Powderfuse Port in Riverglades (new zone, about levels 35-45); ride about 3 min (170 s, estimated from the client path).
detail: Both factions can use it. Riverglades borders Burning Steppes, Redridge, Swamp of Sorrows and Badlands. Factoruide's data has 109 quests in the zone (quest levels 25-60 across the DB, most mid-30s to mid-40s). Ride time is Factoruide's estimate from client TaxiPathNode path 11391; flight paths in Riverglades are not yet documented.

title: Dalaran <-> Stormwind (Wizard's Sanctum) portals are Skyborne-only
claim: The portals between Dalaran's Sky Enclave and Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum can be used only by Skyborne characters, in both directions (player reports).
detail: Factoruide removed these portals from non-Skyborne routes on Oct 14, citing player reports and noting it has not been checked in game. Other Alliance races reach Dalaran (City of Dalaran dungeon, 28-33) over land through Alterac Mountains. Needs a second source.

title: No shared mob tagging in Forever
claim: Forever keeps Classic mob tagging (the first player or group to tag a mob gets the kill); Blizzard said it 'must hold the line' and will adjust quests that players cannot complete instead.
detail: Josh 'Aggrend' Greenfield on X (Sept 21) and in PC Gamer; Johnny Cash said problem quests would be adjusted. Related official changes: group quest drops are round-robin (n:20261012-group-quest-drop-round-robin), faster respawns for crowded quests (n:20261009-respawn-fixes-oct8). For leveling: group up (party credit) on contested kill quests rather than racing solo; at launch, crowded starting zones will be slower.

title: Open beta stress test on Oct 19
claim: A 'WoW: Forever - Stress Test' entry in the Battle.net launcher opens on Oct 19 for accounts without beta access, for several hours; the beta itself ends Oct 22.
detail: Blizzard's beta announcement said a stress test would let anyone try Forever; the date comes from the launcher entry (Icy Veins and Warcraft Tavern). Expect crowded layers that day; no level cap or character-carryover details.

title: Factoruide: personal fastest-route optimizer app + addon for Forever
claim: Factoruide (brouznouf/factoruide, v0.8.0 Oct 14) simulates the whole 1-60 playthrough (travel, fights, drops, quest and mob XP, trainers, gear) and searches for the fastest route for your race, class, professions and dungeon choices, then guides it in game.
detail: Its Forever database (data/forever.sqlite.zst, 43 MB) merges QuestieDB (5,226 quests, 3,494 with XP), VMaNGOS, AllTheThings, Wowhead, an in-game collector (85 quest XP values observed) and client DB2 tables from build 70374 (TaxiPath/TaxiPathNode, QuestXP, Talent, AreaTable, terrain). overrides/forever/travel.toml has the new boats, the Zephras Isle exits and Skyborne portals. Grouping, rested XP, hearthstone, mage teleports and Astral Recall are modeled. Useful as a cross-check for Glide's route and travel model.
